items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: I knew them all. They had Willie Pierre's and she was on Franklin Street.

ctx.x: Yeah. How much would they get for a trick? Short time. Well...

From a dollar on up to three, five the most. They had Lula Whites. They had... They had the Stag Hotel there which was on Basin Street. And there was a view on Franklin Street there. Franklin and Colette Tower. I knew them all. They had Willie Pierre's and she was on Franklin Street. And the front was on Basin Street. And sometimes a lot of musicians would go up there. They had a piano and the piano would play with... Sort of play the balloons or something. Or something soft. They had a piano and they... It was…
The place would run all the way through the block from Franklin to Basin. Yeah.
